description: Ratchets of the query plan (internal/queryplan), one section per gate; a count may only fall, and LVP_QUERY_PLAN_UPDATE=1 rewrites the section of the test that ran. `logical` is the logical plan built from every query of the in-repo corpus: how many rows parse and build (all of them), and the spots the plan still holds as text, per construct (typing them lowers the count).
